# PR 230 correctness review

Head: c97d37c509be2e99d29f60f844b78229e0574c28
Result: pass-with-notes

The config change is correct: `.omp/mcp.json` is valid JSON containing exactly
`{"mcpServers": {}}`. There are no remaining tracked Perplexity references in
`.omp`, `harness`, `skills`, or `docs`; an additional `rg --hidden` search of those
paths also returned no matches.

`just link` delegates to `runLinkGlobal`; `just doctor` reaches its
`--doctor-omp` path through `just omp-doctor`. Shared-file linking and doctor
validate the managed symlink, not a nonempty server list. A dependency-free Node
fixture imported the reviewed implementation and used the exact reviewed config
in isolated checkout/home directories. Fresh link, idempotent relink, and doctor
passed. Existing real files remain protected, doctor still reports their link
drift, and the linked-worktree guard refuses before touching the supplied home.
No machine-global links or settings were changed.

The PR body explains the per-seat process/memory and startup-timeout reason, and
why retaining the old repo config would reintroduce the server during setup.

N230-001: Scrub the machine-local investigation pointer outside pij's layout from
the public PR body (C21). Keep the rationale; a local pathname is unnecessary.
This is a body-only hygiene note, not a configuration correctness defect.

Cost: no new loop, poll, timer, hook, or launch. The removed definition eliminates
the npx wrapper/server startup per OMP seat; this review makes no measured fleet
before/after claim.

Evidence:
- `just pr-freeze 230 --worktree`: passed; exact remote/API head agreement,
  clean merge, ready status, passing latest checks, and valid Delivers.
- `git grep -n -i -e perplexity HEAD -- .omp harness skills docs`: exit 1,
  expected for zero matches.
- `node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning pr230-link-check.mjs`:
  passed all isolated link/doctor/preservation/guard assertions.
- `gh pr checks 230 --repo AI-Substrate/pij-fleet`: all five checks passed.
- `harness boot --json`: advisory `ready:false` because this detached worktree
  has no node_modules; no dependency links were created or borrowed. Vitest was
  not run locally; exact-head CI supplies suite evidence. Full harness checks
  were not run, as requested.

Harness feedback: the existing link-global test already exercises an empty JSON
config. A small optional improvement is to use the actual `mcpServers:{}` shape
and assert zero server entries, pinning the no-MCP ruling. No source changes
were made during this read-only review.
